answer: The admission bond is time locked for 20 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in sable, expire in willow, and atlas lists each expiry. An attacker running 66 aliases therefore needs 11 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2783 identities would post 2286 proofs and burn roughly 31 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
